conformity_share.sampling_frame: SYN-0010 agreed conclusions (live); planted controls excluded

report.headline: planted labelled correctly; live_agreed_attributed=0 live_share=0/0 (UNIVERSE-EMPTY); planted_share=2/3
report.null_model: Sampling frame: the SYN-0010 agreed-conclusion universe (live), with planted controls scored in a separate table and never mixed into the live share. Conformity share = |CONFORMITY| / |frame|. Chance-corrected agreement (SYN-0010) is not reused here; this unit attributes already-agreed items by lineage intersection after ancestor closure. An empty live universe yields an undefined share (UNIVERSE-EMPTY), not 0%. A high SYN-0010 coefficient with a high conformity share is a warning, not a result.

the bottleneck is lock contention on the hatch mutex

report.question: Question: for each conclusion the independent syntheses agreed on, is the agreement traceable to INDEPENDENT source lineage, or to one shared upstream artifact every agent read? Target: label each agreed conclusion CORROBORATED (>=2 independent lineages) or CONFORMITY (one shared ancestor), because N agents reading the same stale input is one lens, not N. Distinct from SYN-0010, which measures the amount of agreement without explaining it.
report.warning: a high SYN-0010 agreement coefficient with a high live conformity share is a warning, not a result

residual_unknowns.claim: Live SYN-0010 agreed-set attribution is scoped to this worktree (reason=SYN-0010-absent; attributed=0). An empty live universe is UNIVERSE-EMPTY, not 0%.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Place a schema-valid SYN-0010 receipt with a non-empty agreed set and SYN-0008 partition manifests on this worktree, then re-run live_attributions().

retry.policy: zero retries. The first observation IS the verdict; a later run that disagrees is a DISCREPANCY to record, never an error to retry away
